data.long_meaning: Elumalai is a Tamil name derived from the Tamil words ‘Elu’ which means hill and ‘Malai’ which means mountain or hill. The name Elumalai is believed to be associated with Lord Subramanya or Murugan, who is the deity of hills and mountains. In Hindu mythology, Lord Subramanya is also known as Kartikeya or Skanda and is the son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati. Elumalai is a revered name in Tamil Nadu and is often used to honor the divine presence of Lord Subramanya.
